cases.why: the lock run has no timeout again, so a hung step holds it for GitHub's six-hour default instead of failing, opening its issue and leaving time to run it again before kickoff
the lock run's timeout is six hours, so a hung Thursday run fails at about 22:00 UTC, leaving little time to run it again before the Thursday night kickoff it was meant to lock
the second job of a two-job workflow loses its timeout, which a check reading only each file's first job would miss
